subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-deactivation contract should OpenClaw support after Voice Wake starts Talk Mode?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public Talk lifecycle/config behavior and changes when an active voice session shuts down, so automation should not choose the durable product contract alone.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical `talk` idle-timeout setting with explicit units, bounds, reset events, and disabled value, then apply it to the approved Talk session scope.

options.title: Scope only to Voice Wake-triggered Talk
options.body: Implement idle deactivation only for sessions started by Voice Wake, preserving manual Talk Mode behavior until a broader lifecycle policy is approved.

options.title: Keep current manual exit behavior
options.body: Decline a new setting for now and leave Talk Mode active until the user exits or existing hard-stop behavior applies.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical `talk` idle-timeout setting with explicit units, bounds, reset events, and disabled value, then apply it to the approved Talk session scope.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent Talk config/runtime history and is the clearest owner for the public config/product contract choice.
